## Essential packages

```r
pkgs <- c(
  "ggplot2",     # Core visualization
  "ggthemes",    # Extra themes (economist, wsj, fivethirtyeight…)
  "hrbrthemes",  # Typography-centric themes
  "ggdark",      # Dark mode themes
  "mdthemes",    # Markdown-enabled themes
  "patchwork",   # Combine plots with operators
  "ggrepel",     # Non-overlapping labels
  "ggtext",      # Markdown/HTML in text elements
  "gridExtra",   # grid.arrange() layouts
  "cowplot",     # plot_grid() publication layouts
  "scales",      # Axis formatting helpers
  "dplyr",       # Data wrangling
  "tidyr"        # Reshaping data
)
install.packages(pkgs)
```

---

## ggplot2 template

```r
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data = <DATA>, mapping = aes(<MAPPINGS>)) +
  <GEOM_FUNCTION>(
    mapping  = aes(<MAPPINGS>),
    stat     = <STAT>,
    position = <POSITION>   # "identity","stack","dodge","fill","jitter"
  ) +
  <SCALE_FUNCTION>   +
  <COORDINATE_FUNCTION> +
  <FACET_FUNCTION> +
  <THEME_FUNCTION>
```

---

## Aesthetics

| Aesthetic | Maps to | Use |
|-----------|---------|-----|
| `x`, `y` | Axis position | All geoms |
| `colour` | Stroke / point colour | Points, lines, box outlines |
| `fill` | Fill colour | Bars, boxes, areas, densities |
| `size` | Point size / line width | Points, lines |
| `shape` | Point shape (0–24) | Points |
| `alpha` | Transparency (0–1) | All geoms |
| `linetype` | Line style (1–6) | Lines, borders |
| `label` | Text string | `geom_text`, `geom_label` |
| `group` | Grouping (no visual) | Lines, polygons |

---

## Geoms — complete list

### One variable

| Geom | Chart | Key args |
|------|-------|----------|
| `geom_bar()` | Bar (count rows) | `stat="count"` |
| `geom_col()` | Bar (use y values) | `fill`, `width` |
| `geom_histogram()` | Histogram | `bins`, `binwidth` |
| `geom_density()` | Kernel density | `adjust`, `alpha` |
| `geom_dotplot()` | Dot plot | `binwidth` |
| `geom_freqpoly()` | Frequency polygon | `binwidth` |
| `geom_rug()` | Marginal rug | `sides = "b"` |

### Two variables

| Geom | Chart | Key args |
|------|-------|----------|
| `geom_point()` | Scatter | `size`, `shape`, `alpha` |
| `geom_jitter()` | Jittered scatter | `width`, `height` |
| `geom_line()` | Line (sorted x) | `linewidth`, `linetype` |
| `geom_path()` | Line (data order) | `linewidth` |
| `geom_step()` | Step line | `direction="hv"` |
| `geom_smooth()` | Trend line | `method`, `se` |
| `geom_area()` | Area chart | `fill`, `alpha` |
| `geom_ribbon()` | Band | `ymin`, `ymax`, `alpha` |
| `geom_boxplot()` | Box plot | `notch`, `outlier.shape` |
| `geom_violin()` | Violin | `trim`, `scale` |
| `geom_errorbar()` | Error bars | `ymin`, `ymax`, `width` |
| `geom_tile()` | Heatmap tiles | `fill` |

### Reference / annotation

| Geom | Purpose | Key args |
|------|---------|----------|
| `geom_hline()` | Horizontal line | `yintercept` |
| `geom_vline()` | Vertical line | `xintercept` |
| `geom_abline()` | Diagonal line | `slope`, `intercept` |
| `geom_segment()` | Line segment | `x`,`y`,`xend`,`yend`,`arrow` |
| `geom_curve()` | Curved segment | `curvature`, `arrow` |
| `geom_text()` | Text labels | `label`, `nudge_y` |
| `geom_label()` | Text + box | `label`, `fill` |
| `annotate()` | Ad-hoc shapes | `"text"`,`"rect"`,`"segment"` |
| `geom_polygon()` | Filled polygon | `fill`, `colour` |

### From extension packages

| Package | Geom | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| `ggrepel` | `geom_text_repel()` | Non-overlapping text |
| `ggrepel` | `geom_label_repel()` | Non-overlapping labels |
| `ggtext` | `geom_richtext()` | HTML/Markdown annotations |
| `ggridges` | `geom_density_ridges()` | Ridge / joy plots |
| `ggbeeswarm` | `geom_beeswarm()` | Beeswarm scatter |
| `ggsignif` | `geom_signif()` | Significance brackets |

## Scales

### Axis scales

```r
scale_x_continuous(breaks, labels, limits, expand, trans)
scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)
scale_x_log10()          # log10 X
scale_y_log10()          # log10 Y
scale_x_reverse()        # reverse X axis
scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m", date_breaks = "1 year")
scale_x_discrete(limits = c("A","B","C"))
```

### Colour & fill — discrete

```r
scale_colour_manual(values = c("#e84855","#2d6be4","#12a36a"))
scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")        # ColorBrewer palettes
scale_colour_viridis_d()                   # viridis discrete
scale_colour_grey(start = 0.2, end = 0.8) # greyscale
```

### Colour & fill — continuous

```r
scale_colour_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred")
scale_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0)
scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma")
scale_colour_distiller(palette = "RdBu")
```

### Axis label formatting

```r
library(scales)
scale_y_continuous(labels = comma)                         # 1,000,000
scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) # 45%
scale_x_continuous(labels = dollar)                        # $1,000
scale_x_date(labels = date_format("%b %Y"))
```

## Labels

```r
labs(
  title    = "Main title",
  subtitle = "Subtitle",
  caption  = "Source: …",
  tag      = "Fig. 1",
  x        = "X axis", y = "Y axis",
  colour   = "Legend title"   # or fill =, shape =, size =
)
ggtitle("Title", subtitle = "Sub")
xlab("X label");  ylab("Y label")
```

---

## Faceting

```r
facet_wrap(~ var)
facet_wrap(~ var, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
facet_wrap(~ var, scales = "free")       # or "free_x","free_y"
facet_wrap(~ var, strip.position = "bottom")

facet_grid(rows ~ cols)
facet_grid(rows = vars(r), cols = vars(c))
facet_grid(rows ~ cols, scales = "free", space = "free")
facet_grid(. ~ var)    # columns only
```

---

## Coordinates

```r
coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,10), ylim = c(0,50), expand = FALSE)
coord_flip()                  # swap x and y
coord_polar(theta = "y")      # pie chart
coord_trans(y = "log10")      # visual transform
coord_fixed(ratio = 1)        # equal unit length
scale_x_reverse()             # reverse x
scale_y_reverse()             # reverse y
```

## Built-in themes

```r
theme_grey()       theme_bw()        theme_linedraw()
theme_light()      theme_dark()      theme_minimal()
theme_classic()    theme_void()
# All accept base_size = 12
```

## theme() — key arguments

```r
theme(
  # Text
  plot.title       = element_text(face="bold", size=16, hjust=0),
  plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour="grey50"),
  plot.caption     = element_text(hjust=1, size=9),
  axis.title       = element_text(size=11),
  axis.text        = element_text(size=10),
  axis.text.x      = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
  legend.title     = element_text(face="bold"),
  strip.text       = element_text(face="bold"),

  # Rectangles
  plot.background  = element_rect(fill="white"),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill="#f5f5f5"),
  panel.border     = element_rect(fill="transparent", colour="grey80"),
  legend.background= element_rect(fill="white"),
  strip.background = element_blank(),

  # Lines
  panel.grid.major = element_line(colour="grey90"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  axis.line        = element_line(colour="grey30"),
  axis.ticks       = element_blank(),

  # Positioning
  legend.position  = "top",   # "top","bottom","left","right","none",c(x,y)
  legend.direction = "horizontal",
  legend.key.size  = unit(0.8, "cm"),
  plot.margin      = margin(16, 16, 16, 16),
  panel.spacing    = unit(1, "lines"),
  plot.title.position = "plot"
)
```

### element functions

```r
element_text(family, face, colour, size, hjust, vjust, angle, margin)
element_line(colour, linewidth, linetype)
element_rect(fill, colour, linewidth, linetype)
element_blank()   # remove element
```

## Combining plots

```r
library(patchwork)
p1 + p2                    # side by side
p1 / p2                    # stacked
(p1 | p2) / p3             # nested
p1 + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 2)
p1 + p2 & theme_minimal()  # apply to all
p1 + p2 + plot_annotation(title = "Title", tag_levels = "A")
wrap_plots(list_of_plots, ncol = 2)
plot_spacer()               # empty gap

library(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, layout_matrix = matrix(c(1,1,2,3), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE))

library(cowplot)
plot_grid(p1, p2, labels = "AUTO", align = "hv", rel_widths = c(2,1))
```

## Save plots

```r
ggsave("plot.png",  width=8,  height=5, dpi=300)
ggsave("plot.pdf",  plot=p,   width=10, height=7)
ggsave("plot.svg",  device="svg")
ggsave("plot.tiff", dpi=300)

# units: "in","cm","mm","px"
```

## Common patterns

### Complete styled scatter

```r
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("4"="#e84855","6"="#2d6be4","8"="#12a36a"),
                      name = "Cylinders") +
  labs(title    = "Vehicle Weight vs Fuel Economy",
       subtitle = "mtcars dataset — 1974 Motor Trend",
       caption  = "Source: Henderson & Velleman (1981)",
       x = "Weight (1,000 lbs)", y = "Miles per Gallon") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position  = "top",
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

### Reusable custom theme

```r
my_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "#6b6760", margin = margin(b=10)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#ede8df"),
    legend.position  = "top",
    plot.margin      = margin(16, 16, 16, 16)
  )

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() + labs(title = "My plot") + my_theme
```

### Faceted with highlight

```r
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(data = transform(mtcars, cyl = NULL), colour = "grey85", size=2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(cyl), labeller = label_both) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("4"="#e84855","6"="#2d6be4","8"="#12a36a")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
